propositions: Four read-only deterministic functions in git_metrics.py must compute module-size distribution, cap-change events, churn (insertions/deletions), and refactor-to-addition ratio from git history and the current module-size-limit.txt single-sourced cap.

Each function must be registered as a MetricSpec in REGISTRY with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', and wrapped in a context-adapter compute that extracts repo_root/since/until and calls the raw function.
module_size_distribution must scan src/rebar/**/*.py at a ref, read the cap from .github/module-size-limit.txt, and return {count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, max_loc}.
cap_change_events must parse git log over .github/module-size-limit.txt and return a list of {commit, old_limit, new_limit} dicts, or [] for ranges with no cap change.
churn and refactor_to_addition_ratio must derive from git log --numstat; refactor_to_addition_ratio must return None when total insertions is 0 to avoid division by zero.
